function mulMod(int $a, int $b, int $mod): int
{
    $base = 1000000;
    $low = $b % $base;
    $high = intdiv($b, $base);

    $x = ($a * $low) % $mod;
    $y = ((($a * $high) % $mod) * $base) % $mod;

    return ($x + $y) % $mod;
}

    while ($exp > 0) {

        }
        $base = mulMod($base, $base, $mod);
        $exp = intdiv($exp, 2);
    }

        if ($n === $p) {

        }
        if ($n % $p === 0) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    $d = $n - 1;
    $s = 0;
    while (($d & 1) === 0) {
        $d = intdiv($d, 2);
        $s++;

        if ($a >= $n) {

        $x = powMod($a, $d, $n);

        $composite = true;

            $x = mulMod($x, $x, $n);
            if ($x === $n - 1) {

        }
    }

        }
        $result *= $base;

function primePowerBase(int $value): int

            if (isExactPower($base, $exp, $value) && isPrimeNumber($base)) {
                return $base;
            }
        }
    }

    return 0;
}

        if ($p > intdiv($remaining, $p)) {
            break;
        }

        if ($remaining % $p === 0) {
            $count = 0;
            while ($remaining % $p === 0) {
                $remaining = intdiv($remaining, $p);
                $count++;
            }
            $factors[] = [$p, $count];
        }
    }

    if ($remaining > 1) {
        $factors[] = [$remaining, 1];
    }

    $divisors = [1];

    foreach ($factors as [$prime, $exponent]) {
        $current = $divisors;
        $power = 1;

        for ($e = 1; $e <= $exponent; $e++) {
            $power *= $prime;
            foreach ($current as $value) {
                $divisors[] = $value * $power;
            }
        }
    }

    return $divisorCache[$n] = $divisors;
}

function firstPrimeGreaterThan(int $value): int
{
    global $primes;

    $left = 0;
    $right = count($primes);

    while ($left < $right) {
        $mid = intdiv($left + $right, 2);
        if ($primes[$mid] <= $value) {
            $left = $mid + 1;
        } else {
            $right = $mid;
        }
    }

    return $left;
}

function countSolutions(int $remaining, int $lastPrime): int
{
    global $primes, $memo;

    if ($remaining === 1) {
        return 1;
    }

    $key = $remaining . ':' . $lastPrime;
    if (isset($memo[$key])) {
        return $memo[$key];
    }

    $answer = 0;

    // Exponent 1: J(p) = p + 1.
    foreach (getDivisors($remaining) as $factor) {
        if ($factor <= 2) {
            continue;
        }

        $p = $factor - 1;
        if ($p > $lastPrime && isPrimeNumber($p)) {
            $answer += countSolutions(intdiv($remaining, $factor), $p);
        }
    }

    // Exponents at least 2: J(p^k) = p^k + 1.
    $start = firstPrimeGreaterThan($lastPrime);
    $primeCount = count($primes);

    for ($i = $start; $i < $primeCount; $i++) {
        $p = $primes[$i];

        if ($p > intdiv($remaining - 1, $p)) {
            break;
        }

        $power = $p * $p;

        while ($power < $remaining) {
            $factor = $power + 1;

            if ($remaining % $factor === 0) {
                $answer += countSolutions(intdiv($remaining, $factor), $p);
            }

            if ($power > intdiv($remaining - 1, $p)) {
                break;
            }

            $power *= $p;
        }
    }

    return $memo[$key] = $answer;
}
